Voltrove · Filament One · v2.4

A whole synth, in your browser.

No download, no plugin. The Filament One is a two-oscillator subtractive synthesizer with an analog-style resonant filter, ADSR envelopes, a feedback delay, a step sequencer, and a live oscilloscope. Everything below makes real sound through the Web Audio API. Press a key.
